documents.name: Heureka
documents.summary: Heureka is a science discovery destination in Vantaa, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Finland’s flagship interactive science centre remains unusually experiment-led and accessible across school ages.

documents.name: Sámi Museum Siida
documents.summary: A high-quality Sámi culture and northern-nature museum paired with an open-air trail of historic structures in the actual Inari landscape.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Cultural authority, excellent visual interpretation and an open-air collection in the Sámi homeland make this far more than a conventional regional museum.

coreExperience.note: Interpretive text and audio matter, with strong English support.

digital.note: English mobile guidance supports the outdoor collection.

mobility.note: The outdoor trail is most accessible in snow-free summer/autumn conditions.

weather.label: Outdoor museum depends on weather
weather.note: Dress for Arctic conditions; the outdoor component changes substantially by season.

documents.name: Moominworld
documents.summary: Moominworld is a story park destination in Naantali, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A highly specific, walk-through Moomin story world that excels for preschool and younger school-age children rather than chasing thrill rides.
